description: The bar chart illustrates the number of input and output requests across four different context length ranges (2K, 4K, 8K, and 16K). The vertical value axis is labeled "Number" and employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120,000 with numerical tick marks at intervals of 20,000. The horizontal category axis organizes the data into four sequential groups from left to right based on increasing context length, though the axis itself lacks explicit text labels directly beneath the groups. The chart features grouped bars, pairing an "Input" measurement with an "Output" measurement for each context length, as defined by a two-row legend positioned below the chart. Input bars are denoted by solid color fills, while output bars of the corresponding category color feature a diagonal slash (hatched) pattern. All bars are visually emphasized with thick black outlines and include precise numerical annotations positioned directly above them. The first group represents the 2K range, featuring a solid pale yellow 2K-Input bar annotated with 9320 and a hatched pale yellow 2K-Output bar annotated with 78188. The second group details the 4K range, pairing a solid light orange 4K-Input bar at 3784 with a hatched light orange 4K-Output bar, which stands as the tallest bar in the chart at 108494. The third group depicts the 8K range, showing a solid light blue 8K-Input bar at 1401 and a hatched light blue 8K-Output bar at 17865. The final group illustrates the 16K range, containing a solid steel blue 16K-Input bar, which is the shortest bar overall at 832, alongside a hatched steel blue 16K-Output bar at 4247.
